items.title: An unsolicited offer is a starting point, not a price.
items.body: Inbound interest is a sign your business is valuable. Before you share numbers or sign an NDA, get an independent view of what the company is worth and who else might pay more.

process.title: A clear path from first call to closing.
process.lead: No surprises. You always know where the process stands and what comes next.

steps.title: Discovery and valuation
steps.body: We learn your business, your goals and what a great outcome means to you. Then we give you a realistic view of value and what moves it.

steps.title: Preparation and positioning
steps.body: We prepare the financials, the story and the materials buyers will scrutinize, so issues are found by us, not by them.
steps.note: Most value is created before the process starts.

steps.title: Confidential buyer outreach
steps.body: We approach a curated list of strategic and financial buyers from our network, under NDA, and manage every conversation.

steps.title: Negotiation and due diligence
steps.body: We create competitive tension, compare offers on price, structure and terms, and keep diligence moving so momentum is never lost.

steps.title: Closing and transition
steps.body: We work alongside your attorneys and accountants through signing and closing, and help plan a transition that protects your team and your clients.
